high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "planetarysociety." The post features an educational graphic about the Lucy Mission, which was launched by NASA. The graphic illustrates the orbits of Jupiter, Earth, and the Sun, along with the positions of the L4 and L5 Trojan asteroids. Graphic Content: The central part of the image shows a diagram of the solar system. The Sun is depicted at the center, with a smaller circle representing Earth's orbit around it. A larger circle represents Jupiter's orbit, which is much larger than Earth's.
